_comment: TALIC country master imported from NBRCOUNTRY_01122025.xls. Full per-country FATF + per-product (TERM/NON_TERM/ATPD/CI/HCB/SURGI) flags in `countries[]`. Legacy 3-bucket lists (`decline.countries`, `acceptable.countries`, `standard_with_caveat.countries`) carry country NAMES only (no 2-letter codes) so the renderer's _classify_nri_country() can do word-boundary lookups without matching codes as substrings of unrelated country names (e.g. 'NG' in 'SINGAPORE').

standard_with_caveat._comment: Either STD=Y but TERM!=Y, or STD=N but FATF=N
